title: API Key Management
description:
Create API Key Management System with Scoped Permissions and Analytics

Implement a complete API key generation and management system that enables users to create, manage, and monitor programmatic access to the platform through API keys with granular permission controls.

Requirements:

API Key Generation:
- Generate cryptographically secure API keys with unique identifiers
- Display the full key only once at creation time with clear warning
- Store only hashed versions of keys in the database
- Support multiple keys per user/organization
- Allow users to name/label keys for identification purposes

Permission Scoping:
- Define granular permission scopes (read, write, delete) per resource type
- Allow users to select specific scopes when creating keys
- Enforce scope-based access control on all API endpoints
- Support role-based templates for common permission sets
- Validate requests against key permissions before processing

Expiration Management:
- Allow users to set optional expiration dates for keys
- Implement automatic key deactivation upon expiration
- Send notifications before keys expire (e.g., 7 days, 1 day)
- Support both date-based and time-to-live expiration options
- Provide renewal workflow for expiring keys

Usage Analytics:
- Track API requests per key (timestamp, endpoint, response status)
- Display usage metrics dashboard (total requests, success rate, rate limit status)
- Show last used timestamp for each key
- Provide usage graphs and trends over time
- Support filtering and exporting usage data

Key Management Interface:
- List all active and expired keys with metadata
- Enable/disable keys without deletion
- Revoke keys immediately with confirmation
- Rotate keys while maintaining access continuity
- Search and filter keys by name, status, or creation date

Security Considerations:
- Implement rate limiting per API key
- Log all key operations (creation, revocation, usage)
- Detect and alert on suspicious usage patterns
- Support IP whitelisting for keys (optional)
- Ensure keys are transmitted only over HTTPS

Edge Cases:
- Handle concurrent requests with same key
- Manage key conflicts during rotation
- Address timezone issues for expiration
- Handle deleted users with active keys
- Support bulk key operations for administrators
